title: Healthcare clinical claim audit bundle
description: Clinical evidence, authorization, coding, claim review, and a healthcare ontology sliver.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: healthcare-claims-audit
  title: Healthcare clinical claim audit bundle
  description: Clinical evidence, authorization, coding, claim review, and a healthcare ontology sliver.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-cross-09
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/healthcare
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs:
        - patient.patient_member_id
        - clinical_encounter.service_description
        - healthcare_claim.claim_number
        - healthcare_claim.claim_status
        - care_authorization.authorization_id
        - care_authorization.request_status
        - diagnostic_result.test_results
      relationshipIds: [receives, delivered_by, billed_as, governed_by, produces]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/healthcare/prior_auth, role: start }
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/healthcare/eob_cms1500, role: review }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/healthcare/clinical_note_soap, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/healthcare/lab_report, role: supporting }
  bindings:
    - id: member-to-clinical-intake
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/healthcare/prior_auth, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/1/fields/2 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-cross-09, path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/instructions }
      ontologyPropertyRef: patient.patient_member_id
      direction: input
    - id: service-to-coding-review
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/healthcare/prior_auth, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/1/fields/7 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-cross-09, path: /spec/nodes/2/prompt }
      ontologyPropertyRef: clinical_encounter.service_description
      direction: review
    - id: claim-to-billing-audit
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/healthcare/eob_cms1500, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/1/fields/0 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-cross-09, path: /spec/nodes/3/prompt }
      ontologyPropertyRef: healthcare_claim.claim_number
      direction: review
    - id: authorization-to-audit-intake
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/healthcare/prior_auth, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/1/fields/0 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-cross-09, path: /spec/nodes/1/prompt }
      ontologyPropertyRef: care_authorization.authorization_id
      direction: input
